mission.title: Trace Route
mission.description: Trace the Assassin's movements back through his blowfly code trail.

npc.say: Man, I'm having a hard time focussing on work. I wonder what she's doing right now...
Hey, you seem cool. We're throwing a bachelor party for Danial later--feel free to stick around, it should be a blast.
I can open one of those doors, but I'll need permission from Ms. Myers first.
I hope you found what you were looking for in there!
Like I said, go ahead and tell Jeffrey that he has my permission to let you in that sealed room.
Oh, is the bachelor party starting already? Good, this mask is really itchy.

phase.briefing: {player}, you are assigned to help find the entity who killed the Zion leader, Morpheus. This entity is popularly known as the "Assassin." Sector scans of areas where the Assassin has been seen indicate that the subject leaves behind multiple deceased specimens of Calliphora vicina, the common blowfly. These particular flies share a unique code structure that we can track. You will begin the search at the Assassin's first known location.

enter.say: A scanner has been implanted in your body. Do not worry--it will not hurt you. It allows us to detect the unique code structure of the Assassin's blowflies in your vicinity. Search the indicated area in that building. The sensor should be able to pick up the Assassin's trail.

done.say: Code signature detected. Tracing. Vector found. Triangulating. Location locked. Leave the area and proceed to the new scan point.

phase.briefing: In effect, we are tracing the Assassin's movements backwards in time. This next area is now his earliest-known location.

enter.say: Again, explore the area until we pick up the Assassin's code trail.

done.say: Code signature detected. Tracing. Vector found. Triangulating. Location locked. Leave the area and proceed to the new scan point.

phase.briefing: Your waypoint will direct you to the new scan point.

enter.say: Explore the area until we detect the Assassin's blowfly code signature.
The far door is sealed shut. Maybe you can convince one of those workers to open it for you.
The door opposite is also sealed shut.

talk.say: Oh, yeah, I don't know why we keep that room locked. I can get you in there... Well, actually you'd better ask my boss, Ms. Myers, first. Go talk to her and then get back to me.
How irksome. You had better to talk to Trish Myers then, {player}. If she does not cooperate then you may have to use force.
Excuse me, who are you again? Huh, never heard of them. Well, I suppose you couldn't do too much harm in there anyway. Sure, tell Jeffrey that he can let you in that sealed room.

done.say: Jeffrey Seekins should be willing to open one of those sealed doors now.

talk.say: She said fine? Okay, let's go get that door open for you.

done.say: That door should be open now.
Code signature detected. Tracing. Vector found. Triangulating. Triangulation failed. We need more data. Continue exploring the area.
That door should be open now.
Code signature detected. Tracing. Vector found. Triangulating. Location locked. Leave the area and proceed to the new scan point.

phase.briefing: Follow your waypoint to the new scan area, human.

enter.say: The Assassin's blowfly code trail is getting fainter as we go farther back in tracing his movements. We are boosting the power to the scanner in your body. You may feel some slight... discomfort; this is normal. Do not be alarmed.

done.say: Code signature detected. Tracing. Tracing failed. Boosting power. Tracing. Vector found. Triangulating. Location locked. Leave the area and proceed to the new scan point.

phase.briefing: The next scan point location is uploading to you. Your internal scanner is now near maximum power. Painful sensations are normal. We are monitoring your vital signs.

enter.say: There appears to be a heavy Exile presence in that area.

done.say: Hacking that system disrupted some of their security measures.
You are close to the trace origin of the last scan.
The last trace ends there. No further signature detected. A dead end? Unlikely. There is an active computer system there. Search it.
You should be able to access the contents of that computer now.

objective.text: Get the contents of the computer

done.say: You have found code fragments of unknown origin. They match part of the Assassin's blowfly signature. Upload the fragments to us at a hardline for analysis.

objective.text: Upload the code fragments at a hardline

done.say: Analyzing fragment data... Ah, this is a code profile of the Assassin. Intriguing.

mission.finish: You may be interested to know that the Assassin is composed entirely of that custom blowfly code--this explains why we detected no other code structures associated with his activity. He is an entity composed entirely of flies: a formidable opponent. As a reward for your service, we are removing the scanner implanted in your body. You may feel a slight... sting. This is normal.
